name: Vim lite
author: Flow
description: A small set of Vim's keys for writing: Normal, Insert and Visual modes, motions, operators, counts and a register. A widget beside undo and redo shows the mode and what each command just did.

settings.label: Start in
settings.description: The mode a script opens in.

settings.label: Leave Insert with
settings.description: Two keys typed quickly, such as jk, that work like Escape. Leave it empty to use only Escape.

settings.label: Block cursor
settings.description: Outside Insert mode, draws the cursor over the character it's on.

settings.label: Mode widget
settings.description: Shows the mode, the keys typed and what they did, beside undo and redo. Tap its mode to switch between Normal and Insert.
